description: Search signed Brazilian government contracts (contratos) from the official PNCP portal (Portal Nacional de Contratações Públicas). Covers federal, state, and municipal agencies under Lei 14.133/2021. Returns each contract with its PNCP control id, object (Portuguese), global value in BRL, supplier name and tax id (CNPJ/CPF), contracting agency, state/municipality, and signing/validity dates. Dates are YYYYMMDD and filter by PNCP publication date; omit them to get roughly the last 30 days.

date_from.description: Start date (PNCP publication) as YYYYMMDD, e.g. "20260501". Defaults to ~30 days ago.

date_to.description: End date (PNCP publication) as YYYYMMDD, e.g. "20260601". Defaults to today.

name: brazil_search_contracts
title: Brazil Search Contracts
